_meta.name: 发送早安
_meta.description: 每天定时发送早安消息给微信好友，包含恋爱天数、生日倒计时等信息
_meta.author: Artifical0

parameters.content: 请将下方「启动微信聊天」步骤中的「输入微信id wxid开头的」替换为你好友的微信 wxid

parameters.script:
-- ================= 配置区 =================
local start_date = {year = 2024, month = 3, day = 26}
local birthday1 = {month = 11, day = 23}
local birthday2 = {month = 6, day = 26}

-- ================= 工具函数 =================
local function get_total_days(y, m, d)
    local start_time = os.time({year = y, month = m, day = d, hour = 0, min = 0, sec = 0})
    local now_t = os.date("*t")
    local current_zero = os.time({year = now_t.year, month = now_t.month, day = now_t.day, hour = 0})
    return math.floor((current_zero - start_time) / 86400)
end

local function get_countdown(m, d)
    local now_t = os.date("*t")
    local today_zero = os.time({year = now_t.year, month = now_t.month, day = now_t.day, hour = 0})
    local target_time = os.time({year = now_t.year, month = m, day = d, hour = 0})
    if target_time < today_zero then
        target_time = os.time({year = now_t.year + 1, month = m, day = d, hour = 0})
    end
    return math.ceil((target_time - today_zero) / 86400)
end

-- ================= 核心计算 =================
local total_days = get_total_days(start_date.year, start_date.month, start_date.day)

-- 1. 恋爱天数：#年#天
local years = math.floor(total_days / 365)
local remaining_days = total_days % 365
local love_display = (years > 0) and (years .. "年" .. remaining_days .. "天") or (total_days .. "天")

-- 2. 分数逻辑 (2.0 到 23.0)
local idx = total_days % 43
local denom = 2 + (idx * 0.5)
local denom_str = (denom % 1 == 0) and string.format("%d", denom) or string.format("%.1f", denom)

-- 【强行截断百分比】保留两位小数，不依赖 string.format
local raw_percent = 100 / denom
local percent_val = math.floor(raw_percent * 100 + 0.5) / 100

-- 3. 平方立方
local sq = 11 + (total_days % 9)
local cb = 2 + (total_days % 15)

-- 4. 生日计算
local b1 = get_countdown(birthday1.month, birthday1.day)
local b2 = get_countdown(birthday2.month, birthday2.day)

-- ================= 组装报告 =================
-- 强制拼接字符串，避免在格式化时出错
local report = "早安宝宝！☀️\n"
report = report .. "📅 今天是：" .. os.date("%Y-%m-%d") .. "\n"
report = report .. "------------------\n"
report = report .. "💡 今日速记：1/" .. denom_str .. " = " .. percent_val .. "%\n"
report = report .. "📐 今日算力：" .. sq .. "²=" .. (sq*sq) .. " | " .. cb .. "³=" .. (cb*cb*cb) .. "\n"
report = report .. "------------------\n"
report = report .. "❤️ 恋爱天数：" .. love_display .. "\n"
report = report .. "🎂 生日：" .. b1 .. "天 | 生日：" .. b2 .. "天\n"
report = report .. "👆🏻 记得吃早饭哦！"

return { result = report }

parameters.command: am start -n com.tencent.mm/.ui.chatting.ChattingUI --es Chat_User "输入微信id wxid开头的"
